subject: Request: short sandbox extension while procurement validates vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@greenleafhealth.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@greenleafhealth.com, samira.p@greenleafhealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — can we pause sandbox timer while PO processes?

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood. We hit an internal snag: our vendor onboarding team needs a couple more business days to validate the Redwoodsupply vendor profile. Procurement confirmed they raised a PO but it won't be fully approved until next Tuesday.

We were due to hit a hard demo cutoff on Friday and I'd hate for the PoC to stall. Can Redwood temporarily extend our sandbox (or issue a short voucher) so our devs can finish integration work while procurement finishes the PO?

If helpful, I can share the PO draft (attached) and an internal approval timeline. Appreciate any short-term help you can provide.

Best,
Tom Nguyen
Sr. Engineering Manager, Greenleaf Health

Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we pause sandbox timer while PO processes?

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft. I looped Camila (solutions) and Stephanie (growth) to coordinate a short-term option while procurement completes validation.

Short answer: yes, we can help keep your environment active. Two pragmatic options depending on what you need most:

- 7-day sandbox extension (no change to billing, we keep the environment live)
- 5k-token voucher to cover immediate test runs while your PO clears

If you can confirm which you'd prefer, and share the expected PO approval date, I’ll route the extension and notify our provisioning team. If procurement wants a written SOW or billing contact, send that over and we’ll accelerate.

I’ve provisionally held a 7-day extension slot pending your confirmation.

—Avery

We do need a short written confirmation of the sandbox extension and a billing contact for the invoice (we prefer to receive it after PO is approved). Please advise if Redwood requires a signed SOW before facilitating this.

Subject: Re: Quick ask — can we pause sandbox timer while PO processes?

Thanks for the update. We can do the following to keep your PoC uninterrupted:

- Provision a 10-day sandbox extension effective immediately (covers the 72-hour ask plus a small buffer).
- Generate a 5k-token voucher as an alternate; vouchers are visible in your console and can be consumed immediately.
- We don’t require a signed SOW to enable the extension; a PO after approval is sufficient for billing. We will, however, need a billing contact/email to send the invoice once the PO clears.

Please confirm which option you prefer; if no reply by EOD tomorrow we will apply the 10-day extension as the least disruptive choice. I’ve attached a short voucher stub and the internal ticket for traceability.

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
